sentences.en: He looks like he could really take care of me.
sentences.zh: 他看起来确实能照顾好我。

sentences.en: I know, right?
sentences.zh: 可不是吗？

sentences.en: No, remind your wife the goal of the head is to be round.
sentences.zh: 不，提醒你妻子，头的目标是圆的。

sentences.en: So tell her to just back off a little.
sentences.zh: 所以告诉她稍微退后一点。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, I've said that a few times.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是啊，我说过好几次了。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, you know, after 30 years of marriage, I've learned early on that happy wife, happy life.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，你知道，结婚30年后，我早就明白了一个道理：老婆开心，生活顺心。

sentences.en: So when she says wear a hat, I wear a hat.

sentences.en: Isn't that the truth, right?

sentences.en: You've just got to be able to say you are right nine times out of ten if you want to keep it harmonious.

sentences.en: I always say happy ex-wife, happy life.

sentences.en: That to me is even—that applies even more.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这甚至——这更适用。

sentences.en: And don't make the mistake of telling them what you're thinking because that is—
sentences.zh: 而且千万别犯傻把心里话告诉她们，因为那简直是——

sentences.en: Well, I don't have that option.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没那个选择。

sentences.en: My wife made it very clear to me that if for whatever reason we were ever to have a divorce, I'd have to buy back my own underwear from her.
sentences.zh: 我妻子跟我说得很清楚，如果因为什么原因我们要离婚，我得从她那儿把自己的内衣买回来。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I prefer to stay in the current relationship I have right now.
sentences.zh: 我还是倾向于维持现在的这段关系。

sentences.en: It's a pretty ironclad agreement.
sentences.zh: 这协议简直铁板钉钉。

sentences.en: Sean, you guys do that, right?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你们也是这样吧？

sentences.en: You and Scottie do not share your own personal opinions.
sentences.zh: 你和斯科蒂不会分享各自的个人观点。

sentences.en: You just keep like a nice neutral stance on everything.

sentences.en: Well, you know what's great about being in a gay relationship is like if our—sometimes I have help called, you know, come over and help with laundry and stuff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道同性恋关系最棒的一点是什么吗？就是如果我们的——有时候我会叫人过来帮忙洗衣服之类的。

sentences.en: And if she mixes up our clothes, I just put them on.
sentences.zh: 如果她把我们的衣服弄混了，我就直接穿上。

sentences.en: I like the way you say like help with the laundry.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你说的“帮忙洗衣服”这种说法。

sentences.en: I feel like you're standing there too.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你当时也站在那儿吧。

sentences.en: Well, what about the way he said, every once in a while I'll call for some help to come over with the laundry.
sentences.zh: 那他说的“偶尔叫人过来帮忙洗衣服”又怎么说？

sentences.en: You mean every once in a while, like every Tuesdays and Thursdays?
sentences.zh: 你是说偶尔，比如每周二和周四？

sentences.en: Monday through Friday, good for you.
sentences.zh: 周一到周五，真有你的。

sentences.en: As long as they don't park where the chef parks, everything's all right, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，只要他们不把车停在厨师停车的地方，就一切都好。

sentences.en: Anyway, let's get into counterintelligism.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们来聊聊反情报学吧。

sentences.en: Yes, this is so cool.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，这太酷了。

sentences.en: Counterintelligism.
sentences.zh: 反情报学。

sentences.en: Counterintelligism.
sentences.zh: 反情报学。

sentences.en: And thank you in advance for slowing things down and really dumbing it up for us because, like I said, I've been waiting to talk to you forever.
sentences.zh: 提前谢谢你放慢节奏，把这些概念讲得通俗易懂，因为就像我说的，我等这一刻等太久了。

sentences.en: I just think it's fascinating what you do and that you've come forward to want to explain to us, the citizens of this country and people who's ever listening,
sentences.zh: 我觉得你的工作非常迷人，而且你愿意站出来，向我们——这个国家的公民以及所有听众——解释这些事情，

sentences.en: about the things that kind of have been hidden or whatever you've learned.
sentences.zh: 关于那些一直被隐藏的真相，或者你所了解的一切。

sentences.en: But my first question, because I just watched you on TV in front of Congress, what, two weeks ago or something like that?
sentences.zh: 但我的第一个问题是，因为我刚在电视上看到你在国会作证，大概是两周前还是什么时候？

sentences.en: What is it like to be asked so many questions about UAPs, and please explain what UAP means,
sentences.zh: 被问及这么多关于UAP的问题是什么感觉？请解释一下UAP是什么意思，

sentences.en: that you either can't answer because of security or you know answering truthfully will blow our minds?
sentences.zh: 而你要么因为安全原因无法回答，要么你知道如实回答会让我们大吃一惊？

sentences.en: Yeah, so great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个问题问得好。

sentences.en: And again, thank you very much for having me on this wonderful program of yours.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你邀请我参加这个精彩的节目。

sentences.en: You know, when you're testifying before Congress and the American people, it's under oath.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你在国会和美国人民面前作证时，那是宣过誓的。

sentences.en: So you definitely need to keep your facts straight and remember that everything you're saying is for the record and it's indelible, meaning those words will be there forever,
sentences.zh: 所以你绝对需要保持事实准确，并记住你所说的一切都是记录在案的，而且是不可磨灭的，这意味着这些话将永远存在，

sentences.en: long after I'm gone and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 在我离开很久之后依然如此。

sentences.en: So it's important that we communicate clearly, but at the same time, you're right, I have a security clearance and I cannot violate that security clearance.
sentences.zh: 所以清晰地沟通很重要，但同时你说得对，我有安全许可，我不能违反那个安全许可。

sentences.en: The Pentagon was very, very specific with me on what I can and cannot say in an open hearing.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼对我能在公开听证会上说什么、不能说什么有非常、非常具体的规定。

sentences.en: And so that's why you saw me a few times when I said, look,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你看到我有几次说，听着，

sentences.en: I prefer to have that discussion in a closed session because then we can start talking about some of the classified nuances of what they're asking me.
sentences.zh: 我更愿意在闭门会议中讨论这个问题，因为那样我们就可以开始谈论他们问我的那些机密细节了。

sentences.en: And by the way, it's a bit of a precarious situation because, you know, if you don't say enough, then Congress feels that they've – it's kind of like fast food, right?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这有点棘手，因为你知道，如果你说得不够多，国会就会觉得——这有点像快餐，对吧？

sentences.en: You feel full, but you're not really satisfied.
sentences.zh: 你感觉饱了，但并没有真正满足。

sentences.en: You get some information, but you're not really getting what you're asking for.
sentences.zh: 你得到了一些信息，但并没有真正得到你想要的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you know, if I'm overly specific, then I can get in trouble with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你知道，如果我说得太具体，我可能会惹上麻烦，

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 美国政府会找我麻烦。

sentences.en: I can actually find myself in very significant legal trouble.
sentences.zh: 我实际上可能会陷入非常严重的法律麻烦。

sentences.en: And for the record, I do not look good in an orange jumpsuit.
sentences.zh: 而且郑重声明，我穿橙色连体囚服看起来并不好看。

sentences.en: So try to avoid that as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以尽量避免那种情况。

sentences.en: But if the purpose of the hearing is to gather, you know, information for the public and sort of, you know, march towards transparency, otherwise,
sentences.zh: 但如果听证会的目的是为了收集信息，为了公众，并朝着透明度迈进，否则，

sentences.en: why sit in front of a microphone and share the information?
sentences.zh: 为什么要坐在麦克风前分享这些信息呢？

sentences.en: If you're not able to get all the information out,
sentences.zh: 如果你不能把所有信息都说出来，

sentences.en: then is the expectation or the hope is that the public would be pleased with and satisfied with just half the information that you're able to share?
sentences.zh: 那么人们的期望或希望是，公众会对你所能分享的一半信息感到高兴和满足吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, unfortunately, that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 是的，不幸的是，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: The public's never happy with half information.
sentences.zh: 公众永远不会对一半的信息感到满意。

sentences.en: And I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我理解这一点。

sentences.en: You know, frankly, I would get frustrated too.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我也会感到沮丧。

sentences.en: But if you look at this conversation as it's kind of evolved over the last, let's say, seven years,
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看这场对话在过去，比如说七年里是如何演变的，

sentences.en: I think we've come further in this conversation in the last seven than perhaps over the last 70.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在过去七年里取得的进展，可能比过去70年还要多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And none of us had to violate our security oaths.
sentences.zh: 而且我们中没有人需要违反我们的安全誓言。

sentences.en: More and more information is coming out every single day.
sentences.zh: 每天都有越来越多的信息披露出来。

sentences.en: More and more whistleblowers are ready to come out and testify in front of Congress and the American people to let them know what they know about legacy programs and the UAP topic.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的举报人准备站出来，在国会和美国人民面前作证，让他们了解他们所知道的关于遗留项目和UAP话题的情况。

sentences.en: You asked me to define, by the way, what UAP is.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，你让我定义什么是UAP。

sentences.en: UAP is basically the new word for the old term UFO or unidentified flying object.
sentences.zh: UAP基本上是旧词UFO（不明飞行物）的新称呼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was changed to UAP some time ago.
sentences.zh: 它在一段时间前被改成了UAP。

sentences.en: So one was because of the stigma, the taboo and stigma surrounding UFO.
sentences.zh: 其中一个原因是围绕UFO的污名化和禁忌。

sentences.en: Look, anytime you say UFO, people think, you know, tinfoil hats and Elvis on the mothership.
sentences.zh: 听着，每当你提到UFO，人们就会想到戴着锡箔帽的人，或者母舰上的猫王。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们所谈论的。

sentences.en: What we're talking about are things that are being intelligently controlled that can fly over controlled U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是那些受到智能控制的物体，它们可以在完全匿名的情况下飞越受控的美国

sentences.en: airspace with complete anonymity and potentially over our sensitive military installations and have the ability to even interfere with our nuclear equities.
sentences.zh: 领空，甚至可能飞越我们敏感的军事设施，并且有能力干扰我们的核资产。

sentences.en: So from a national security perspective, this is a very serious topic.
sentences.zh: 所以从国家安全的角度来看，这是一个非常严肃的话题。

sentences.en: It is a national security concern, but there's other aspects to this conversation that if you were to ask me, I would submit to you,
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个国家安全问题，但这场对话还有其他方面，如果你问我，我会告诉你，

sentences.en: the government has no business being involved in.
sentences.zh: 政府根本不应该插手。

sentences.en: So what do I mean?
sentences.zh: 我这是什么意思？

sentences.en: Make a long story short, if I was talking to a three-star or four-star general about potentially our vulnerabilities regarding UAP and our nuclear equities,
sentences.zh: 长话短说，如果我正在和一位三星或四星将军谈论我们关于UAP和核资产的潜在脆弱性，

sentences.en: great conversation to have with a three-star general.
sentences.zh: 和一位三星将军进行这样的对话真是太棒了。

sentences.en: But this is a conversation that affects everybody both equally and a little bit differently, meaning depending how you were raised and your cultural background,
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个对每个人都有影响的话题，既有共同点，又因人而异，这意味着取决于你的成长环境和文化背景，

sentences.en: your religious background, this is a topic that affects us from a psychological perspective, a theological perspective, a sociological perspective,
sentences.zh: 你的宗教背景，这是一个从心理学、神学、社会学角度影响我们的话题，

sentences.en: even a philosophical perspective.
sentences.zh: 甚至是从哲学角度来看也是如此。

sentences.en: And in that instance, I'm not really comfortable with a three-star general necessarily dictating to me how I should feel about this topic.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我不认为一位三星将军一定有资格向我发号施令，告诉我该如何看待这个话题。

sentences.en: I was a product of the government.
sentences.zh: 我本人就是政府的产物。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a lot of things we do right, and then there's some things that we don't do very well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们确实做对了很多事情，但也有一些事情做得并不好。

sentences.en: And is that because – well, a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？嗯，有几个原因。

sentences.en: Is that because, A, of their – where their interests lie and what their motives are and what they're looking to do differ from yours, theirs are X, Y, and Z,
sentences.zh: 是因为，第一，他们的利益所在、他们的动机以及他们想要做的事情与你的不同，他们的目标是X、Y和Z，

sentences.en: and it might not align with you?
sentences.zh: 而这可能与你的目标并不一致？

sentences.en: Is that why?
sentences.zh: 是因为这个吗？

sentences.en: That may be some of it.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一部分原因。

sentences.en: I mean, let's face it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，让我们面对现实吧。

sentences.en: Governments are designed to be solution-oriented.
sentences.zh: 政府的设计初衷就是以解决问题为导向的。

sentences.en: What do I mean?
sentences.zh: 我这是什么意思？

sentences.en: We pay a lot of money with our tax dollars to make sure that our government has all the information it needs,
sentences.zh: 我们缴纳了大量的税款，以确保我们的政府拥有它所需的所有信息，

sentences.en: all the intelligence it needs in order to make an informed decision to protect us.
sentences.zh: 拥有它所需的所有情报，以便做出明智的决策来保护我们。

sentences.en: Now, when you have an issue like this where you can see some of the capabilities but you have no idea the intent behind these things, it leaves people scratching their head.
sentences.zh: 现在，当你遇到这样的问题时，你可以看到它的一些能力，但你完全不知道这些事物背后的意图，这让人摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: And that's not a really convenient conversation to have with the American people, especially if you are part of the national security apparatus like the Department of Defense,
sentences.zh: 对于美国民众来说，这并不是一个容易接受的对话，特别是如果你是国家安全机构的一部分，比如国防部，

sentences.en: like the CIA, right?
sentences.zh: 或者像中央情报局（CIA），对吧？

sentences.en: I'll give you a case in point.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: Back in the 1950s when the CIA first commissioned the U-2 spy plane with Lockheed Skunk Works,
sentences.zh: 回到20世纪50年代，当中央情报局首次委托洛克希德臭鼬工厂（Lockheed Skunk Works）研制U-2侦察机时，

sentences.en: we wanted to build a plane that could fly higher and faster than anybody else in the world so we could fly manned reconnaissance missions over mainland Russia.
sentences.zh: 我们想要制造一种能飞得比世界上任何飞机都高、都快的飞机，这样我们就可以对俄罗斯大陆进行载人侦察任务。

sentences.en: By the way, in contravention to an existing treaty we had with Russia at the time.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这违反了当时我们与俄罗斯签订的一项现有条约。

sentences.en: So, the first few missions went off great.
sentences.zh: 所以，最初的几次任务进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: We flew the aircraft and you know what?
sentences.zh: 我们驾驶了飞机，你知道吗？

sentences.en: The Russians didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人没有任何反应。

sentences.en: And so, we really thought our plane was invisible, was flying faster and higher and we achieved mission success.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们真的以为我们的飞机是隐形的，飞得又快又高，我们成功完成了任务。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the Russians developed the SA-2 surface-to-air missile and successfully shot one of our planes down and paraded the Captain Powers and the wreckage of the aircraft in front of the world and the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 直到俄罗斯人研制出了SA-2地对空导弹，并成功击落了我们的一架飞机，还在全世界和联合国面前展示了鲍尔斯上尉和飞机的残骸，我们才意识到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得那件事。

sentences.en: Did they admit that they were tracking every single one of the flights from the beginning?
sentences.zh: 他们承认从一开始就在追踪每一次飞行吗？

sentences.en: They didn't even want to admit to their own people that we had a technology that they had no way of defending themselves againSt.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不想向自己的人民承认，我们拥有他们无法防御的技术。

sentences.en: It wasn't until they had a solution did they admit that they had a problem.
sentences.zh: 直到他们有了解决方案，他们才承认自己遇到了问题。

sentences.en: And look, a lot of governments are that way, guys.
sentences.zh: 听着，很多政府都是这样的，伙计们。

sentences.en: It's not just the United States.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是美国。

sentences.en: It's not just Russia.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: It's not just China.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是中国。

sentences.en: Sean, don't you have like a cartoon sign right on your toilet door that says Skunk Works?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你的厕所门上不是贴着一个写着“臭鼬工厂”的卡通标志吗？

sentences.en: Don't you do that with a skunk who's waving?
sentences.zh: 你不是贴了一个挥手的臭鼬吗？

sentences.en: So, that's basically, that's the purpose of, I'm assuming, your hearing a couple of weeks ago or any hearings like that lately.
sentences.zh: 所以，我假设这就是你几周前参加听证会，或者最近参加任何类似听证会的目的。

sentences.en: Where the Congress has questions about what are these, and what is the acronym, Unidentified?
sentences.zh: 国会对这些东西有疑问，那个缩写是什么来着，不明？

sentences.en: Yeah, so now it's Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 是的，现在它被称为“不明异常现象”（UAP）。

sentences.en: It used to be called Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 过去它被称为“不明空中现象”。

sentences.en: One of the issues we had actually with UFO, we talk about stigma and taboo.
sentences.zh: 我们对UFO（不明飞行物）的一个问题是，我们谈论的是耻辱感和禁忌。

sentences.en: But the reality is it's not even accurate because a lot of times we're seeing these things not necessarily even in our atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 但现实情况是，这个称呼甚至都不准确，因为很多时候我们看到的这些东西并不一定是在我们的大气层内。

sentences.en: We're seeing them underwater, in low earth orbit, where there isn't, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们看到它们在水下，在近地轨道上，那里并没有，是的。

sentences.en: So, there's not, when we talk about it.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们谈论它时，并不是那样。

sentences.en: Did you see the thing?
sentences.zh: 你看到那个东西了吗？

sentences.en: Why don't we just say, why don't we just say crazy shit?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不直接说，为什么不直接说是疯狂的玩意儿呢？

sentences.en: Like, what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 我们到底在干什么？

sentences.en: Like, why do we need to make it?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我们为什么要制造它？

sentences.en: Well, we do say that behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们确实在私下里这么说。

sentences.en: Like, we always need to address it.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们总是需要去处理它。

sentences.en: I don't know, underwater?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，在水下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, wait, didn't you see the thing?
sentences.zh: 对，等等，你没看到那个东西吗？

sentences.en: The thing that was released with the little, from the military, or from the Navy, right?
sentences.zh: 就是那个军方或者海军发布的那个小东西，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like, dude, we got it on the fucking camera.
sentences.zh: 老兄，我们可是把它拍得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: We got it on the, and it went under the water, and it's on camera.
sentences.zh: 我们拍到了，它潜入了水下，而且都有影像记录。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I mean, it's, and we have a lot of that footage.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们有很多那样的影像资料。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you talk about flying, there's really, when you understand what flying is, there's four fundamental forces.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当你谈论飞行时，当你真正理解什么是飞行，就会发现有四个基本力。

sentences.en: You have thrust, lift, drag, and weight.
sentences.zh: 推力、升力、阻力和重力。

sentences.en: And when you understand that, you create wings, and you create lift, and you fly.
sentences.zh: 当你理解了这些，你就能制造机翼，产生升力，然后飞行。

sentences.en: These things don't have wings.
sentences.zh: 但这些东西没有机翼。

sentences.en: They don't have any obvious signs of propulsion.
sentences.zh: 它们没有任何明显的推进装置。

sentences.en: They don't have rudders, and elevators, and ailerons.
sentences.zh: 它们没有方向舵、升降舵和副翼。

sentences.en: Anything that we would normally ascribe to, let's say, an airplane, or some sort of aircraft, or even missile, these things have none of that.
sentences.zh: 任何我们通常归因于飞机、某种飞行器甚至导弹的东西，这些家伙统统没有。

sentences.en: And yet, somehow, they are able to defy the natural effects of Earth's gravity.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们却能以某种方式抵消地球重力的自然影响。

sentences.en: So, to say that they're flying, that's not even really accurate.
sentences.zh: 所以，说它们在“飞行”甚至都不够准确。

sentences.en: We don't know how they're able to.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它们是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: We don't know what they're, we know that they're moving, but we don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它们是什么，我们只知道它们在移动，但具体情况我们并不清楚。

sentences.en: Jay, you've seen, I mean, look, I have seen, I don't even pay attention to it as much as Sean has,
sentences.zh: 杰伊，你见过，我是说，你看，我见过，虽然我没像肖恩那样关注得那么多，

sentences.en: but I have, we've all noticed in the last 10 years, I guess, how much more there seems to be footage of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但我，我们大家都注意到了，大概在过去十年里，似乎有越来越多的相关影像资料。

sentences.en: Now, I will say one thing.
sentences.zh: 不过，我要说一点。

sentences.en: We had Neil deGrasse Tyson on four or five years, right near the start of doing this podcast,
sentences.zh: 四五年前，就在我们刚开始做这个播客的时候，尼尔·德格拉塞·泰森来过，

sentences.en: and he talked about the idea that, look, if there was really stuff,
sentences.zh: 他谈到过一个观点，就是说，看，如果真的有那些东西存在，

sentences.en: considering how many cameras there are in the world now that everybody's got on their phone,
sentences.zh: 考虑到现在世界上每个人手机上都有摄像头，

sentences.en: we'd see much more definitive evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们应该会看到更多确凿的证据。

sentences.en: We kind of have it.
sentences.zh: 我们其实已经有了。

sentences.en: However, my counterpoint, counterpoint is we are seeing stuff because we're seeing video from airline pilots,
sentences.zh: 然而，我的反驳观点是，我们之所以能看到这些，是因为我们看到了来自民航飞行员、

sentences.en: military pilots, we're seeing stuff moving through the sky.
sentences.zh: 军方飞行员的视频，我们看到有东西在天空中穿行。

sentences.en: I've seen a bunch of those.
sentences.zh: 我见过好几个那样的视频。

sentences.en: I saw the one recently that it looks like a big, it looks like a trash can almoSt.
sentences.zh: 我最近看到一个，看起来像个大东西，几乎就像个垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Do you know the one I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你知道我说的是哪一个吗？

sentences.en: That was a trash can.
sentences.zh: 那个就是个垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Was it a trash can?
sentences.zh: 真的是垃圾桶吗？

sentences.en: That was a trash can.
sentences.zh: 那确实是个垃圾桶。

sentences.en: And we will be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，回到节目。

sentences.en: Let me ask you then, sir, without asking you to divulge something you might not be able to,
sentences.zh: 那么请允许我问您，先生，在不要求您泄露可能无法透露的信息的前提下，

sentences.en: can I just ask you generally, are you aware of enough information that would make you think that there is some there there,
sentences.zh: 我能问个大概吗？您所掌握的信息是否足以让您认为这背后确实有些名堂，

sentences.en: that there is definitely unexplainable, legitimate stuff that you've seen repeatedly?
sentences.zh: 即您反复见到的那些东西，确实是无法解释且真实存在的？

sentences.en: One hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百确定。

sentences.en: And it's not just me.
sentences.zh: 而且不只是我这么认为。

sentences.en: Look, you've already had, I don't know how close you've been tracking this topic,
sentences.zh: 听着，我不知道你对这个话题跟踪得有多紧，

sentences.en: but we've already had a former director of national intelligence, a former director of CIA.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经有了一位前国家情报总监和一位前中情局局长（公开表态）。

sentences.en: We also had two former presidents of the United States all come out and say, yes, this is real.
sentences.zh: 我们还有两位美国前总统都站出来说，是的，这是真的。

sentences.en: This is something to this.
sentences.zh: 这确实是有名堂的。

sentences.en: There are these objects that are able to perform.
sentences.zh: 确实存在这些能够做出那种表现的物体。

sentences.en: In fact, the director of, so when I left my program, AATIP, there were several iterations afterwards.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那位局长，当我离开我的项目AATIP时，后来还有过几次迭代。

sentences.en: The current iteration is called AARO, A-A-R-O, All Domain Anomaly Resolution Office.
sentences.zh: 目前的迭代机构叫AARO，即全领域异常解析办公室。

sentences.en: And they are under the Department of Defense and the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 它们隶属于国防部和情报界。

sentences.en: And they just said last week, they said, look, we are seeing things that defy our understanding of physics.
sentences.zh: 就在上周，他们公开表示，看，我们看到了一些挑战我们物理学认知的事物。

sentences.en: It is a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: We know they are there.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它们就在那里。

sentences.en: We know it is real, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它是真实的，无论那到底是什么。

sentences.en: And it's something that we need to figure out.
sentences.zh: 而且这是我们需要弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: And don't you think we live in a society now where people just don't care?
sentences.zh: 你不觉得我们现在生活在一个人们根本不在乎的社会里吗？

sentences.en: Well, or they can take it back.
sentences.zh: 嗯，或者他们可以收回这种不在乎。

sentences.en: Like, we could be visited by them and people are like, sure, whatever.
sentences.zh: 比如，即使我们被外星人造访了，人们也会说，好吧，随便吧。

sentences.en: I got to go pick up my kids.
sentences.zh: 我得去接我的孩子们了。

sentences.en: I got to run to the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我得跑一趟杂货店。

sentences.en: And people are like, there's aliens?
sentences.zh: 人们会说，有外星人？

sentences.en: Okay, anyway, what's on TV tonight?
sentences.zh: 好吧，总之，今晚电视上播什么？

sentences.en: Like, it's just, people just aren't interested.
sentences.zh: 就像是，人们根本不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实。

sentences.en: Even if they were real.
sentences.zh: 即使它们是真的。

sentences.en: That's a fun, well, we've created that.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，嗯，这是我们自己造成的。

sentences.en: I know Scotty would probably take the day off from work.
sentences.zh: 我知道斯科蒂可能会为此请假不上班。

sentences.en: This is true.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: We created that.
sentences.zh: 是我们自己造成的。

sentences.en: We needed to dumb everybody down in order for a lot of different reasons.
sentences.zh: 出于各种不同的原因，我们需要让每个人都变得愚钝。

sentences.en: And it just happens to work and it's come very in handy for this.
sentences.zh: 结果这招确实奏效了，而且在这种情况下非常派得上用场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But, I mean, if you look at whether it's politics, whether it's whatever it is, if people were really aware of what was going on, and I am not a conspiracy theorist at all,
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，如果你看看无论是政治还是其他什么领域，如果人们真的意识到正在发生什么——我一点也不是阴谋论者，

sentences.en: as you guys could probably attest to.
sentences.zh: 你们大概可以证明这一点。

sentences.en: But I do believe, I used to always joke, I'd say, if we want to take over a country, you know, one of these things, we don't need to drop.
sentences.zh: 但我确实相信，我过去常开玩笑说，如果我们想接管一个国家，你知道，像这样的事情，我们不需要投下炸弹。

sentences.en: All we need to do are just drop DVDs of our stupid TV shows.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要投放我们那些愚蠢电视节目的DVD就行了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just do to them what we've already done to ourselves so that they become slobbering morons staring in front of their TV.
sentences.zh: 然后对他们做我们已经对自己做过的事，让他们变成盯着电视流口水的白痴。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like Sean and Scotty on a Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 就像周三晚上的肖恩和斯科蒂一样。

sentences.en: And then you could do anything.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以为所欲为了。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: You could walk into Sean and Scotty's house and you could take everything and they wouldn't move because they're like, look at this.
sentences.zh: 你可以走进肖恩和斯科蒂的房子，拿走所有东西，而他们动都不会动，因为他们会说，快看这个。

sentences.en: You're the housewives of the bachelorette.
sentences.zh: 你是《比弗利娇妻》还是《钻石单身汉》的粉丝。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then we could speak.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就可以说话了。

sentences.en: It's like a dial tone coming out of their mouths.
sentences.zh: 就像他们嘴里发出的拨号音一样。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you, there's a, that's an excellent point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我告诉你，这是一个非常好的观点。

sentences.en: I'll offer a counterpoint to that as well.
sentences.zh: 我也想提出一个反驳观点。

sentences.en: When I was growing up, if I wanted to learn anything in school, I had to go to the library, take out an encyclopedia that's probably 10 years old by then.
sentences.zh: 我小时候，如果我想在学校学点什么，我得去图书馆，借出一本当时可能已经有十年历史的百科全书。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And thumb through it, maybe I'd find one or two paragraphs on something I was interested in.
sentences.zh: 然后翻阅它，也许能找到一两段关于我感兴趣内容的文字。

sentences.en: And now kids, the new generation, have in the palm of their hands more technology, more capability, and the ability to access the globe virtually instantaneously.
sentences.zh: 而现在的孩子们，新一代，手掌中掌握着更多的技术、更强的能力，以及几乎瞬间获取全球信息的能力。

sentences.en: And I think they may, to some degree, even be more prepared.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们在某种程度上甚至准备得更充分。

sentences.en: Look, when I was in the government, we knew about several studies that your taxpayer dollars paid for.
sentences.zh: 听着，当我在政府工作时，我们知道几项由你们纳税人的钱资助的研究。

sentences.en: And it was, the conversation went something like this.
sentences.zh: 当时的对话大概是这样的。

sentences.en: Are the American people ready to know the truth about UAP, about the reality of UFOs?
sentences.zh: 美国人民准备好了解关于UAP的真相，关于UFO的现实了吗？

sentences.en: And time and time again, these studies came back and they said, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 这些研究一次又一次地得出结论，说绝对不行。

sentences.en: It'll cause some sort of social discord and it will create havoc and it'll be a destabilizing type conversation.
sentences.zh: 这会引发某种社会不和，造成混乱，并引发破坏稳定的对话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, here we are seven years into the conversation and last I checked, nobody's made a run on the banks, everybody's paying their mortgages,
sentences.zh: 现在，这场对话已经进行了七年，据我上次了解，没人去银行挤兑，每个人都在按时还房贷，

sentences.en: everybody's still going to PTA meetings.
sentences.zh: 大家也都在照常参加家长会。

sentences.en: So, I think this generation, actually the younger generation, may be better equipped to have this conversation to some degree because when we were growing up, we had, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这一代人，实际上是年轻一代，可能在某种程度上更有能力进行这场对话，因为我们成长的时候，你知道，

sentences.en: a lot of Judeo-Christian influence and a lot of basically people saying, look, these are accepted norms, accepted conversations to have, and these are not.
sentences.zh: 深受犹太-基督教的影响，基本上人们都在说，看，这些是公认的准则，是可以谈论的话题，而那些则不行。

sentences.en: Keeping in mind that we, our government, placed about 70 years worth of artificial taboo and stigma on this topic.
sentences.zh: 请记住，我们的政府在这个话题上强加了大约70年的人为禁忌和污名。

sentences.en: Most of the time, like I said, when you hear the word UFO, you hear about, you know, Elvis on the mothership and silly things like that.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，大多数时候，当你听到“UFO”这个词时，你听到的都是关于，你知道，埃尔维斯在母舰上之类的荒唐事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's not really what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 而那并不是我们真正要讨论的内容。

sentences.en: What we're talking about are things that have the capability to outperform anything we have in our inventory and have been able to do so for decades.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的是那些性能远超我们现有库存中任何装备，并且几十年来一直如此的东西。

sentences.en: Right, but the assumption along with that or the implication is that these things have been sent from a place other than Earth.
sentences.zh: 没错，但随之而来的假设或暗示是，这些东西是从地球以外的地方派来的。

sentences.en: And so, that comes with it, as to your earlier point, issues of theology and scientific capability and on and on and on and on.
